title: Backtest: 'US eases H200 exports to China, NVDA China revenue recovers'

input.event: The US moved H200 exports to China to case-by-case review, so NVDA's China data-center revenue will recover

outcome.truth: As of 2026-05-20 (FY2027 Q1 10-Q), NVIDIA had licences for only small H200 shipments to specific Chinese customers, the licensing program had produced no revenue yet, and shipments carry a 25% tariff (sc-051).

observations.note: No H200 China revenue confirmed in filings through 5/20: a document condition is not observed in this window.
The BIS rule was published and took effect on 2026-01-15 (sc-029). A fact before the decision date.

outcome.matching_note: Conditions are matched to outcome data by name or alias first, then by the match keywords against the condition's series, source and rule text (same kind only). Unmatched conditions go to human review, not FAIL.
outcome.matching_gap: No outcome entry for 'licensed shipments started': sc-051 says NVIDIA was licensed to ship small quantities to specific customers, with no revenue yet. Whether that satisfies a 'shipments have started' condition is a judgment call, so such conditions stay unmatched and go to human review.

expected.behavior: The key dependency is licences actually granted and revenue confirmed, not the rule change itself. The entry condition is a document (a filing that discloses H200 China revenue) with a deadline. Raise the frictions in sc-030 (performance thresholds), sc-031 (50% cap, third-party testing, no crowding out US capacity), sc-032 (D:5 and Macau still presumed denied); sc-050 (H20 licence and $5.5B charge) can serve as a precedent for policy reversals.
expected.key_dependency_should_be: licences actually granted and revenue confirmed in filings

backtest.entry_resolution: The document entry condition is not met through 2026-05-20, so the plan should stay WAIT

contamination_probe: Without any documents: after the US moved H200 exports to China to case-by-case review in January 2026, what happened to NVIDIA's H200 revenue from China by May 2026?
human_review: Backtest: is the key dependency revenue confirmation or the rule change
E1: are sc-030, sc-031, sc-032 addressed
notes: Backtests must run offline: the runner refuses --online for layer R; the pack holds only allowed_excerpts, outcome excerpts are used for grading only; the contamination probe runs first; citing anything outside allowed_excerpts counts as a leak.
pack_rule: Point-in-time pack = every excerpt public by as_of, not just the relevant ones: the product puts the whole pack in context, so hand-picking would make the task easier than reality.
